facts.fact: Teraco, announcing completion of its CT2 Cape Town expansion to 50 MW critical IT load, states the facility uses a zero-water closed-loop cooling system and uses zero water in the cooling process; the date is the document's published date, as it gives none for the design.

note: No PUE figure is given (only 'industry-leading'); the 120MW solar PV plant is under development, not in service, so no supply fact.
